correctness.rationale: Cubic contact is equivalent to zero-sum of six anisotropic vectors of the quadratic space of the 2-torsion of the Jacobian; syzygetic triads are parity-one triple sums. The package reconstructs the geometry and checks all 376740 six-subsets, all 20475 tetrads, all 6048 x 6048 pairs, and a separate full graph traversal with integer-only arithmetic. The result is a complete exact finite proof, not a partial experiment. All source and classification assumptions are explicit.

value.rationale: The pre-existing two families correspond to distinct classical embedded-topological types, so determining which four-line configurations extend to each family is an intrinsically motivated incidence question. The new complete pair-incidence table and graph connectivity show how the distinct families interlock under two-line exchanges. This is a natural complete classification and structural link between known families, not a small numerical improvement to the 1008 and 5040 sizes. The connectedness is explicitly combinatorial, not a claim of deformation.
